description: This file contains the implementation of trigonometric functions related to tangent calculations, including tangent, hyperbolic tangent, arctangent, inverse hyperbolic tangent, and two-argument arctangent, within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Tangent
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating various tangent-related functions including tan, tanh, atan, atanh, and atan2 within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of an angle, validating the input and supporting array input for batch processing.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of an angle, validating the input and supporting array input.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of a number, validating input and supporting array input.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number, validating input and supporting array input.

methods.name: atan2
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of the y/x coordinates, taking into account the signs of both arguments to determine the correct quadrant. Supports array inputs.
